properties.name: archone.messaging.jpa.enabled
properties.description: Whether to compose the legacy JPA Inbox and Outbox repository bridge beans.

properties.name: archone.messaging.producer.jdbc.enabled
properties.description: Whether to compose the transaction-required JDBC Outbox MessageProducer.

properties.name: archone.messaging.jpa.register-package
properties.description: Whether to add the Archone messaging root to Spring Boot auto-configuration packages. Disable when the application root already covers it.
